title: operating_expenditure
description: One operating expenditure: a payment a committee itemized on its FEC report (Schedule B), from the FEC's operating expenditures file (`oppexp`, from 2004), counted or not. Sum only rows where `counted` is true: a sub-item (a card bill's charges, a reimbursement's receipts) is kept beside the payment it itemizes and never added to it. Spending, never a contribution: never add it to `contribution` or any other receipt amount. Payees are grouped by `payee_key`, a normalized name, never resolved. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

source_record_id.description: The FEC's id of the row (`SUB_ID`), unique within a source.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

committee_id.description: The FEC id of the committee that paid.

candidate_id.description: The FEC id of the candidate the paying committee raises for, by the rule that credits a contribution: a principal or authorized committee's candidate, or the one whose filing names it principal; null for any other committee. A committee handed from one candidate to another (Biden's 2024 campaign, Harris's from 2024-07-21) credits the first before the handoff date and the second on and after it, and an undated row the second.

payee_key.description: The payee's name normalized as an organization's is, its legal form stripped and its alias applied: rows sharing it are one payee's. A normalized name, not an id. Null for a row with no name.

payee_is_person.description: True when the payee is a person: the entity type is `IND` or `CAN`, or it is blank and fundlens does not judge the name an organization's.

amount.description: The amount in dollars, as filed. A refund or correction may be negative and nets out in any sum.

date.description: The date of the payment as filed, an impossible year included; null when the filer gave none.

purpose.description: The purpose of the payment as reported.

fec_category.description: The FEC's category code for the payment as a three-digit string (`001` … `107`), a code filed without its leading zeros padded to them; any other value as filed; null when none was filed.

spending_category.description: What the payment bought, one of `media`, `digital`, `mail`, `fundraising`, `payroll`, `consulting`, `field`, `polling_research`, `travel`, `events`, `administrative`, `legal_compliance`, `transfers_fees`, `credit_card` and `other`: fundlens's reading of the purpose, else of the FEC's category code where filers use the code reliably. Null in a build made before fundlens classified spending.

category_source.description: Where `spending_category` came from: `purpose_rule` (fundlens's rule over the purpose), `fec` (the FEC's category code, one of the six fundlens trusts) or `unclassified` (neither, so `other`). Null in a build made before fundlens classified spending.

election_code.description: The FEC election code of the payment (`P2024`, `G2024` …).

report_type.description: The FEC report the row was filed on (`Q1`, `M4`, `YE` …).

amendment_indicator.description: The FEC amendment indicator of the filing (`N` new, `A` amendment, `T` termination).

memo_code.description: `X` for a memo entry, as filed; null otherwise.

memo_text.description: The filer's memo text, as reported.

entity_type.description: The FEC entity type of the payee (`ORG`, `IND`, `CAN` …), or null when the filing left it blank.

tran_id.description: The filer's transaction id for the row.

back_ref_tran_id.description: The filer's transaction id of the row this one refers back to, as filed.

parent_source_record_id.description: For a sub-item, the `source_record_id` of the payment it itemizes: the row on the same committee and filing whose `tran_id` is this row's `back_ref_tran_id`. Null for any other row, one referring back to itself among them.

image_num.description: The FEC image number of the page the row is on.

file_num.description: The FEC filing number of the report the row is on.

is_in_kind.description: True for an in-kind outlay: the spending side of a gift of goods or services, which the committee reports both as a receipt and as spending naming the giver. It refers back to a row this file does not hold, or its purpose says in-kind. Counted in the committee's spending, but the payee was paid nothing.

counted.description: True for a row every total counts: not a sub-item, and either a payment some sub-item itemizes, whatever its memo code, or not a memo entry. Sum only these.
